characterList.description: A middle-aged man with short brown hair and a black polo shirt with a 'Mental Toughness' logo. He is a mental toughness trainer, standing in a studio with a blue-paneled background and a large screen behind him.
characterList.name: Craig Sigel

content_metadata.description: An instructional video by Craig Sigel that explains the 'It's an "AND" World' mental toughness technique, focusing on performing under pressure.
